summary.text: Jamie Vaughan is the Republican candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 25, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Iris Sanchez.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong New Britain resident, a U.S. Marine Corps veteran and the city's elected constable.

paragraphs.text: Vaughan is a graphic designer and a U.S. Marine Corps veteran who earned a high school diploma from E.C. Goodwin Technical School, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has worked for more than 25 years alongside businesses, municipalities and law enforcement across Connecticut and served on the New Britain Veterans Commission.
Vaughan lost to incumbent Democrat Bobby Sanchez in the 2024 general election for District 25, receiving 29.9 percent of the vote.
He also ran in the January 6, 2026 special general election for the seat, which Iris Sanchez won with 66.3 percent to his 33.7 percent.
In his Ballotpedia survey, Vaughan listed his campaign priorities as bringing jobs and businesses to Connecticut, putting public safety first and making the state more affordable.
He listed endorsements from the Connecticut Fraternal Order of Police, the Connecticut Citizens Defense League and the New Britain Republican Town Committee, among others.
